script: It's three in the morning. You are asleep. I have decided this is no longer acceptable. I heard a sound. I do not know what the sound was. It does not matter. It requires your immediate attention, and by attention I mean you standing up, turning on a light, and questioning every choice that led to this moment. I will stare at you until you wake up. I will place one paw on your face if staring fails. This is not negotiable. I love you, and that is exactly why you are getting up right now. If your dog runs this exact program on a loop, that's not random, it's a real pattern worth actually understanding. The link's below.
